metadata.description: Deterministic desktop tier (D19), plus the two-client, sync-refusal and quit-hold suites so every PR runs them (revisions charter D9, EQ12). Named test:e2e so `nx affected -t test:e2e` selects it, and built unpackaged so the Electron shell can run under xvfb on the CI e2e runner. The first command builds the web UI the two-client tier serves on :3014. It must be the cloud variant (TAU_CLOUD_ENABLED is a build-time input of ui:build; a self-host build hands every account canSyncFiles and renders no plan gate, so the entitlement and Upgrade rows could never be observed), and a dependsOn task inherits only the caller's environment, so it is a command under this target's env. TAU_API_URL, TAU_WEBSOCKET_URL and TAU_FRONTEND_URL are that build's e2e fixture, the values ci.yml sets workflow-wide, so a clean checkout needs no untracked apps/ui/.env; the tier's own servers set their runtime origins. parallelism false: that build rewrites apps/ui/build, which ui-e2e serves from, so the two targets must not overlap. The last command runs `sync-refusals.spec.ts` again against an API with charter D23's free-tier sync gate open (`TAU_FREE_TIER_SYNC_ENABLED=true`, which the API reads once at boot): its gate-open rows run only there and every other row only in the first pass, so the gate-closed row still sees the gate closed. Both passes run in one shell command, so the gate-open pass runs even when the first fails, and the target fails if either did. Infrastructure bring-up is `scripts/ensure-services.sh`, shared with every other tier here: it publishes the bootstrap billing policy only on a database that has none, because that publish pins `--expected-head-revision 0` and dies on any database whose head has moved (C65/P70).

commands: ../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/desktop-chat-in-project.spec.ts src/desktop-chat-replay.spec.ts src/desktop-chat-launcher-2.spec.ts src/desktop-mcp-fixture.spec.ts src/desktop-chat-attachments.spec.ts src/desktop-share-link-copy.spec.ts src/desktop-kernel-freshness.spec.ts src/desktop-quit-hold.spec.ts src/desktop-print-dry-run.spec.ts src/two-client.spec.ts src/sync-refusals.spec.ts; first=$?; TAU_FREE_TIER_SYNC_ENABLED=true ../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/sync-refusals.spec.ts; second=$?; exit $(( first || second ))

metadata.description: The kernel-utility cap gate (R5 of docs/research/electron-kernel-utility-cap-blueprint.md): nine live projects in one window, a get_kernel_result turn in the ninth, and the park and return of a hidden one. Kept off test:e2e because the row holds nine kernel utilities at once and waits out the 2-minute park window, neither of which is proven on the Ubuntu e2e runner; promote it once it has been observed green there.

Packaged-app specs (macOS arm64 only: they launch package-out/Tau-darwin-arm64). Kept off `test:e2e` so the Ubuntu e2e runner is not asked for a package it cannot build. `TAU_E2E_DESKTOP_EXECUTABLE` is assigned on the vitest command rather than in `env` because the Assimp and native-payload specs require an absolute path and Nx strips a leading `{workspaceRoot}/` from option values. Its spec list is the one `scripts/run-completed-artifact.mts` runs; a new packaged spec joins both.

commands: TAU_E2E_DESKTOP_EXECUTABLE="$PWD/../desktop/package-out/Tau-darwin-arm64/Tau.app/Contents/MacOS/Tau" ../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/desktop-build123d.spec.ts src/desktop-assimp.spec.ts src/desktop-main-editor-kernels.spec.ts src/desktop-converter.spec.ts src/desktop-ephemeral-isolation.spec.ts src/desktop-image-geospec.spec.ts src/desktop-thumbnail-lifecycle.spec.ts src/desktop-native-payload.spec.ts

metadata.description: External-agent tier (W4-ACP): the desktop's ACP rows, and one real turn through the operator's own Codex login. Kept off test:e2e because it spends their quota and needs the Codex CLI; the spec skips when the adapter or the CLI is absent. It selects the Build123d kernel, so it prepares `resources/python`, which `desktop:build` no longer does.

W18 two-client tier: chromium.launch() beside electron.launch() in one node-side vitest process, a real UI server on :3014 (apps/ui/server.ts, started by the spec), the dedicated API on :4014, and a git http-backend fixture in mktemp. An operator alias since EQ12 folded both suites into test:e2e, which every PR runs; it has the same cloud UI build and env fixture. No dependsOn api:build: that chain reaches runtime:build, which is red on Node 24 for a tsdown config-loader bug, and global-setup.ts builds apps/api itself. The web UI is built by the first command rather than a dependsOn, because it must be the cloud variant (TAU_CLOUD_ENABLED=true is a build-time input of ui:build) and a dependency task inherits only the caller's environment: a self-host build hands every account canSyncFiles and renders no plan gate, so the entitlement and Upgrade rows could never be observed. The last command is the gate-open pass of `sync-refusals.spec.ts` (charter D23; see test:e2e).

commands: ../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/two-client.spec.ts src/sync-refusals.spec.ts; first=$?; TAU_FREE_TIER_SYNC_ENABLED=true ../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/sync-refusals.spec.ts; second=$?; exit $(( first || second ))
